description: This file defines the RecognitionException class, which is part of the ANTLR error handling hierarchy used for parsing and recognizing tokens in a language parser. It provides mechanisms to capture contextual information about recognition errors in parsing processes.

classes.name: RecognitionException
classes.description: An exception class representing recognition errors during parsing, encapsulating detailed positional and context information about where and why the recognition failed.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with contextual input stream information, capturing position, token, node, and character data relevant to the error.

methods.name: extractInformationFromTreeNodeStream
methods.description: Internal method to extract positional and token information from a tree node stream when the exception arises in that context.

methods.name: getUnexpectedType
methods.description: Returns the type or character of the unexpected input element that caused the recognition error.
